changes: Fixed remaining macOS permission prompts and file-index loss after skipping onboarding permissions
The top-bar listening control now shows the Only Meetings icon in place of the microphone while that mode is selected, reads as on while armed for a call, and explains the mode in its tooltip
The chat composer now always reads "Ask Omi" instead of "Ask a follow-up…"
Fixed black transparent bands being baked into Rewind window captures
Chat stays smooth while an answer streams through a conversation
Improved recall of screen information across voice and chat, with clearer responses when source content is unavailable
Improved how voice distinguishes remembering screen information from creating tasks and reminders
Fixed conversation durations that showed the whole recording session instead of the conversation, so a short capture no longer reads as tens of minutes
Bug fixes and improvements
Added Undo Last Dictation in supported editors and clearer recovery when dictation cannot be inserted safely
Voice typing is now faster for simple, already-clean English dictation
Made locked listening visible in the notch with a stop and send control, and added clearer push-to-talk and dictation guidance
Offline voice questions stay available for five minutes for review or copy without being sent automatically
Added recent screen frames to the chat paperclip menu, so you can attach what you were looking at as an image

Fixed "what's on my screen?" asked from Omi's own window answering with Omi's interface — it now answers from the most recent frame of the app you were actually in, and when you switch into your first real app, the on-screen prompt includes that frame for you
Improved chat responsiveness with reusable Markdown rendering and a more compact composer with consistent Send and Stop controls
Added image pasting to the chat composer, so ⌘V with a screenshot or a copied file stages it as an attachment
Hardened the local agent runtime state used by proactive JIT processing
Improved proactive JIT notifications so reasoning requests stay within the backend budget and failures retain actionable diagnostics
You can now attach a file, image, or conversation and press Return without typing anything; Omi responds to the attachment directly.
Attached files, images, and conversations are now treated as the subject of your message, so Omi answers about the attachment instead of describing your screen.
Voice typing now capitalizes sentence starts and the pronoun "I" even when the AI cleanup is unavailable
Completed realtime voice conversations now keep their final answer in conversation history

Clicking the daily summary card in the notch now opens the app on that day's recap page; the click previously did nothing, and a plan/permission card that cannot open a conversation now opens the app's chat instead of ignoring the tap
Bug fixes and improvements
Fixed planned reminders not firing when a matching app was on screen but that context was not independently notification-worthy
Bug fixes and improvements

Chat answers no longer run the pre-tool sentence and the post-tool continuation together when Omi pauses to think or search mid-turn ("...handle it.Capture the context..." now renders as two properly separated sentences)

Fixed the remaining scrunched-notch states: closing a conversation over a notification card, a card auto-dismissing under an open chat, card replacements, and the moment a voice hold releases no longer collapse the notch to its resting width while wider content is still showing.
Bug fixes and improvements
Voice typing now always copies (or pastes) what you dictated instead of occasionally asking Omi to type it for you when Accessibility access hasn't been granted
Bug fixes and improvements
Fixed the Unlimited plan's fallback description showing the wrong monthly question count
Typing with no text field focused now starts a search in the page's search bar (or lands in the chat composer on Chat) instead of playing the system alert sound
Free-plan Pendant recording on Apple Silicon now uses on-device transcription instead of forcing the cloud STT path.
Settings search field placeholder now reads "Search"
Free-plan screen proactivity now stops on the plan gate instead of retrying paid Gemini calls, and a mid-session voice quota close shows the usage-limit prompt.
Bug fixes and improvements
Bug fixes and improvements

Named test bundles now inherit shortcuts and settings from your installed Omi app — production first, Omi Dev when production is absent — instead of always mirroring a stale Omi Dev; the launch log warns and names the effective hotkey default when the source app has none set, and auth seeding falls back to your production session when Omi Dev's has expired
Bug fixes and improvements
The daily recap in Chat history is now its own card — day, emoji, title, overview, and the day's stats — and the once-a-day announcement no longer adds a generic bell notification on top of it
Ambient proactive notifications now let you mark a reminder Useful or Not relevant
Improved proactive knowledge tools and standing notification setup in Chat
